> **Note:** This panel only appears on Free Wili boards built with the CC1101 sub-GHz radio installed; it won't show up on boards without that hardware option.

Found under **Wireless** on the device's panel list.

## Sub-GHz Radios

The Sub-GHz application is intended for receiving, recording, analyzing, and
transmitting signals with the onboard CC1101 radios.

### Availability

CC1101 panels are not included in the current FreeWili 2 firmware release.
Selecting **Wireless > SubGHz** may therefore open an empty screen. Use Home to
return to the launcher.

The separate **LoRa** application is available and uses the WIO-E5 radio. See
its help page for receiving and sending LoRa data.

When CC1101 support is enabled in a future release, this application will
provide these tools:

- Read received packets
- Capture raw signals
- Transmit saved `.sub` files
- Scan signal strength by frequency

Radio transmission is regulated. Only transmit on frequencies and at power
levels permitted in your location.

## Sub-GHz Receive Log

This panel is designed to show packets received by either onboard CC1101
radio. A received packet includes its data, signal strength, link quality, and
CRC result.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Gray | Send a test packet |
| Yellow | Switch between Radio 1 and Radio 2 |
| Green | Clear the log |
| Blue | Return to the Sub-GHz menu |
| Cancel | Open this help page |

### Availability

The CC1101 application, including receive logging, is not included in the
current FreeWili 2 firmware release. See **Sub-GHz Radios** for availability
information.

## Sub-GHz Raw Capture

Raw Capture records Sub-GHz pulse timing and saves it as a `.sub` file on the
SD card. Use the configuration view to choose the frequency, radio preset,
capture duration, and output name before recording.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Gray / Yellow | Move through configuration fields |
| Center | Edit the highlighted field |
| Green | Start or stop capture |
| Blue | Return to the previous view |
| Red | Open or close configuration, as labeled |
| Cancel | Open this help page |

Keep the device close to the transmitter during capture. A clean recording
usually contains one or more complete button presses with a short quiet period
before and after them.

### Availability

The CC1101 application is not included in the current FreeWili 2 firmware
release. See **Sub-GHz Radios** for availability information.

## Sub-GHz Signal Files

This panel lists saved Sub-GHz signal files from the `/radio/` folder on the
SD card. Selecting a file opens it in the transmit panel; it does not transmit
immediately.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Up / Down | Move through the file list |
| Center | Open the highlighted file |
| Blue | Return to the Sub-GHz menu |
| Cancel | Open this help page |

Files must use the `.sub` format. If the list is empty, confirm that the SD
card is mounted and that the files are stored in `/radio/`.

### Availability

The CC1101 application is not included in the current FreeWili 2 firmware
release. See **Sub-GHz Radios** for availability information.

## Sub-GHz Transmit

This panel transmits the signal stored in the selected `.sub` file. The
screen shows the file name, radio settings, and transmit status.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Gray | Transmit once |
| Yellow | Change the repeat count |
| Green | Start or stop repeated transmission |
| Blue | Return to the signal-file list |
| Cancel | Open this help page |

The frequency, modulation preset, protocol, and signal data come from the
selected file. A malformed or unsupported file is rejected without sending.

### Availability

The CC1101 application is not included in the current FreeWili 2 firmware
release. See **Sub-GHz Radios** for availability information.

Radio transmission is regulated. Only transmit signals you are authorized to
use, on frequencies and at power levels permitted in your location.

## Sub-GHz Frequency Analyzer

The Frequency Analyzer scans supported Sub-GHz frequencies and plots received
signal strength. Use it to find active channels before opening a receive or
raw-capture panel.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Gray / Yellow | Change the highlighted scan setting |
| Green | Start or pause scanning |
| Blue | Change the frequency range or layout, as labeled |
| Cancel | Open this help page |
| Home | Return to the launcher |

A taller or brighter peak indicates a stronger signal at that frequency. RF
noise can also produce peaks, so repeat the scan while operating the
transmitter you want to identify.

### Availability

The CC1101 application is not included in the current FreeWili 2 firmware
release. See **Sub-GHz Radios** for availability information.

**See also:** [Radio](../features/radio.md) — the console/GUI commands for this panel.
